text:
zoe: Heads-up from onboarding: SDK pager stopped mid-stream and we later got a 401. Repro in sampleapp.

ravi: Minimal repro? snippet + curl pls.

zoe: JS repro:
```js
// sampleapp/pager.js
const it = client.routes.list({limit: 50}).autoPaginate();
for await (const r of it) { handle(r) }
```
curl that works:
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/routes?limit=50&cursor=page_2"` returns 200 and server includes `x-next-cursor: page_3` header.

carla: Wait I thought REST moved to `meta.next_cursor` in body?

zoe: That's the mess: hosted returns header `x-next-cursor`, private returns body `meta.next_cursor`, legacy had top-level `next_cursor`. Our SDK only checks `resp.next_cursor` and `resp.meta?.next_cursor`. Header-only case ends pagination early. Then client retries later and server responds 401 because ephemeral creds weren't rotated.

mike: Ah — auth refresh mismatch too?

zoe: Yup. Backend sometimes sends `x-rotate-ephemeral=true` or `x-ephemeral-refresh: 1` but SDK only watches for `x-auth-refresh`. So even when server signals rotation, SDK doesn't refresh and subsequent requests fail.

ravi: Two separate interoperability bugs: pagination location (header vs body/top-level) and auth-refresh header name drift.

carla: Proposed quick fixes:
1) Pager normalization: const cursor = resp.meta?.next_cursor ?? resp.next_cursor ?? resp.headers?.['x-next-cursor']; unify into a single cursor var.
2) Defensive pager: if (!cursor) break; and surface a debug metric/log "pager: unknown pagination shape".
3) Auth: accept `x-auth-refresh`,`x-rotate-ephemeral`,`x-ephemeral-refresh` truthy values as refresh triggers.

mike: Add unit matrix in CI: mock responses for header-only, meta-body, and top-level cursor. Also tests for each auth header name.

zoe: I pushed a WIP: branch `chore/sdk-pager-compat-2148` with failing tests: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/1442

devex-bot: CI for sdk-js/pull/1442 failed on node 18: `AssertionError: expected pager to call next_page 3 times but called 1 time`

ravi: In tests, ensure fake Response objects include `.headers` mapping. Our test harness adapter sometimes returns headers on `res.rawHeaders` only which the SDK adapter didn't read. Add adapter shim.

carla: Also audit other list_* endpoints (models, keys, deployments) for same gap. Likely rollout was staggered across environments.

zoe: Small follow-ups: add compatibility blurb to SDK changelog, update onboarding quickstart to mention pagination header vs body, and include a debug flag that logs unknown pagination keys.

mike: Low-risk patch. Mark P1 for onboarding flow, P2 for general docs update.

ravi: I'll create board ticket and link PR. Once tests are adjusted we can land the normalization and auth header support.

zoe: Thanks — will update PR with test adapter and defensive null-checks. Will post back when CI green. :rocket:
